## Profile

and 3+ years in applied AI. Builds production Python services, voice agents
and RAG workflows using FastAPI, LangGraph and AWS.
Immediately available for fully remote work from India.

## Technical Skills

- Backend and delivery: Python, FastAPI, REST APIs, SQL, Docker, Kubernetes,

- Cloud and developer tools: AWS Bedrock, Lambda, EC2, S3, Claude Code, Cursor

## Experience

### Careers360 — AI Engineer, Voice AI & Conversational Systems
Hyderabad, India | January 2026 - September 2026

- Built a voice counselor serving 10K+ sessions using Claude on AWS Bedrock,
  Sarvam AI and pgvector; RAG grounding reduced hallucinations by 35%.
- Built multi-agent function-calling workflows improving accuracy by 28%,
  deployed on AWS Lambda with 99.7% uptime.
- Reduced per-session costs by 40%, from $0.40 to $0.24, through prompt
  caching and A/B testing; tracked latency, cost and quality in LangSmith.

### Crystaltech Services — AI Engineer
Remote, India | August 2024 - December 2025

- Built a four-agent LangGraph workflow processing 500+ documents at 94%
  accuracy; reduced handling time from 30 minutes to 7 minutes.
- Improved retrieval from 85% to 91% with hybrid search and Cohere reranking.
- Tracked 50+ LLM iterations in W&B; A/B tested GPT-4 and Claude
  configurations, achieving 60% cost savings.

### STL Digital Limited — System Engineer (AI/ML Focus)
Pune, India | June 2022 - July 2024

- Built a ChromaDB and GPT-3.5 RAG system improving accuracy from 65% to 91%,

- Reduced validation errors by 60%; deployed a Streamlit dashboard on AWS
  for 500+ daily users, with pytest at 85% coverage and GitHub Actions CI/CD.
